jobs.title: Manufacturing Material Coordinator
jobs.description_text:
About Neuralink:

We are creating devices that enable a bi-directional interface with the brain. These devices allow us to restore movement to the paralyzed, restore sight to the blind, and revolutionize how humans interact with their digital world.

Team Description:

The Implant Assembly team builds Neuralink's brain-computer interface implants on the Austin production line. The team runs every step of the build, from array bonding through sealing, cleaning, inspection and acceptance testing. We work closely with Microfabrication, Shipping & Receiving, Quality, and R&D to deliver high-quality implants on schedule.

Job Description and Responsibilities:

As the Manufacturing Material Coordinator, you will own the flow of material on the implant assembly line, so that operators can spend their time building implants. You will make sure every station has the right parts, fixtures and supplies before the shift starts, keep inventory records accurate, and coordinate with Microfab, Shipping & Receiving, and R&D so that material shortages do not stop the line.

Responsibilities:

  • Own core inventory control and audits for consumables, fixtures, and implant components, including cycle counts and keeping records accurate in our inventory system
  • Receive supplies from Shipping & Receiving

The Medical Imaging team at Neuralink is responsible for supporting preclinical, clinical, and R&D operations across the company. Our multidisciplinary group of scientists, medical physicists, and engineers work in lockstep to test hypotheses and validate safety within preclinical models. We lead the medical imaging screening process for human participants seeking to receive the Neuralink implant, collaborating closely with Radiologists and Neurosurgeons. jobs.title: Senior Accountant, Cost and Manufacturing Accounting
jobs.description_text:
About Neuralink:

We are creating devices that enable a bi-directional interface with the brain. These devices allow us to restore movement to the paralyzed, restore sight to the blind, and revolutionize how humans interact with their digital world.

Team Description:

The Finance Team at Neuralink plays an important role in fueling our mission to develop groundbreaking brain-machine interfaces that restore autonomy to individuals with unmet medical needs. The Accounting Team oversees the Company’s core financial operations, including the preparation of financial statements, corporate tax filings, equity administration, insurance management, and treasury functions. The team also plays an important role in handling technical accounting issues from identification, research, and implementation to monitoring and revision.

Job Description and Responsibilities:

Build the foundation of Neuralink’s cost accounting function in a complex, vertically integrated manufacturing environment. We design and build our own brain implants, including micron-scale electrode threads and the needle cartridges that insert them, along with the surgical robot that places them. As the first dedicated owner of cost accounting, you will establish how we capture, allocate, and report manufacturing costs, then own and improve these processes as our manufacturing capabilities scale.

jobs.title: Lead Bioinformatics & Machine Learning Scientist (Epigenomics)
jobs.description_text:
Natera is currently seeking a Lead Bioinformatics & Machine Learning Scientist to contribute to research and development within our Bioinformatics Research and Development team, focused on Epigenomics in Oncology. The team develops machine learning methods for early cancer detection from cell-free DNA methylation data. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in machine learning and statistical modeling, as well as genomics and sequencing data analysis. The successful candidate will be instrumental in developing and expanding state-of-the-art machine learning methods for early detection of cancer, and will provide technical leadership and mentorship within a highly collaborative team.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Drive technical workstreams within a collaborative team that takes methods from problem definition through delivery of final classifiers to downstream validation teams
  • Design, implement, and validate novel machine learning and statistical methods to solve problems in cancer diagnostics
  • Establish and promote best practices in model interpretability, uncertainty estimation, and reproducibility

jobs.title: Lead Biostatistician (IVD Analytical)
jobs.description_text:
This is an exciting opportunity to advance Natera’s regulated product portfolio of cutting-edge molecular diagnostic tests. As a Lead Biostatistician, you will leverage your strong applied statistics and IVD expertise to oversee the design, analysis, and interpretation of R&D and analytical validation studies for complex biomarkers used in the screening, monitoring, and management of cancer.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead Biostatistics efforts designing and executing analyses for analytical validation studies in support of CLIA LDT and in vitro diagnostic approvals (e.g., IVDR, 510(k), PMA, etc.).
  • Perform relevant statistical analyses (e.g., sample size, power, agreement, precision, LoD calculations) for validation studies of varying complexity
  • Produce high quality presentations and author documentation of analysis plans, methods, results, and interpretation
  • Effectively convey statistical concepts and results to cross-functional internal and external collaborators and stakeholders
  • Identify risks, communicate concerns, and champion solutions to interdisciplinary project teams

jobs.title: Manager of Statistical Programming

jobs.title: Senior Director of AI Diagnostics
jobs.description_text:
Natera is hiring a Senior Director to lead the research, development and clinical translation of AI and computational algorithms for oncology diagnostics, from research prioritization through validation, deployment, and ongoing performance monitoring. Natera’s longitudinal oncology data resources span tumor genomics, ctDNA, transcriptomics, pathology images, and clinical outcomes, creating opportunities to develop and validate models across molecular, imaging, and clinical data. This role turns that data into multimodal AI products that change how oncologists treat patients. 

We are looking for a scientific leader with a compelling vision for how foundation models can advance oncology diagnostics. You will shape our foundation model strategy - identifying the highest-value opportunities in longitudinal molecular, imaging, and clinical data, defining the capabilities we need to build, and guiding their translation into clinically useful products. This requires both the imagination to pursue new possibilities and the judgment to establish where these approaches deliver meaningful advantages.  You will lead an established algorithm team, develop its technical and leadership capabilities, and recruit talent aligned with the product roadmap. With Product and other partners, you will set strategy and decide which opportunities move toward clinical deployment.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Scientist, Biomolecular Structure Prediction
jobs.description_text:
Profluent is the frontier AI lab for biology. Profluent builds powerful foundation models for all of life's molecules, unlocking solutions that transform medicine, agriculture, and beyond. Founded in 2022 and headquartered in Emeryville, CA, Profluent is backed by leading investors including Altimeter Capital, Bezos Expeditions, Spark Capital, Insight Partners, Air Street Capital, AIX Ventures, and Convergent Ventures and has raised over $150M to date.

We're looking for a motivated and creative Machine Learning (ML) Scientist to drive research into biomolecular structure prediction. You will build and improve all-atom co-folding models, with a focus on the complexes that matter most to our programs: antibody–antigen interfaces and protein–nucleic acid assemblies. These remain among the hardest cases for current models, and closing that gap directly accelerates our antibody design and genome editing work.

The ideal candidate has trained structure prediction models at a leading academic or industry lab and knows where today's models break. You will be a self-directed researcher who moves quickly from hypothesis to trained model to rigorous evaluation. As an early member of the ML team, you will help shape how structure modeling fits alongside our generative models (ProGen3, E1) and experimental platforms.

Point72’s Operations team supports all operational aspects of trade processing, reconciliation, financing, and reporting firmwide for all products, including equities, derivatives, bonds, foreign exchange and futures, and digital assets across global markets. The team provides opportunities to build deep operational expertise and broad exposure across the firm, supporting internal mobility and long-term career development.

A Career with Point72's Risk and Quantitative Research (RQR) Team

The RQR team plays a vital role in the firm’s investment process, building a deeply rooted culture of efficient risk management and factful performance attribution. Quantitative risk analysts perform research to identify opportunities for improved risk management, investment behavior, and portfolio construction, with the goal of helping the firm deliver superior risk-adjusted performance. The paramount mission of the team is to protect the firm from improper levels of exposure and ensure that risk-taking is always efficient and deliberate.

What you'll do

  • Analyze private credit portfolios to identify key drivers of risk, return, concentration, liquidity, and downside exposure
  • Partner with investment teams to review private credit transactions, including deal structure, borrower fundamentals, covenants, downside risks, and key diligence findings
  • Evaluate borrower fundamentals, capital structures, covenants, and deal terms to assess potential vulnerabilities across private credit investments
  • Monitor the private credit portfolio, including performance, exposures, concentrations, risk limits, and emerging company or sector-level issues
  • Ensure accurate tracking of portfolio activity, key terms, risk metrics, and performance trends
  • Prepare weekly and ad hoc reporting for senior risk management, business leaders
